coherence_stylistic.explantion: Both responses were judged to maintain a consistent formal academic style with uniform tone, complexity, and perspective. No tonal clashes, complexity mismatches, perspective shifts, or abrupt style shifts were reported for either response. As a result, according to the tie condition, the appropriate adjudication is a tie.

coverage_broad.explantion: Both responses suffer from the same high‑severity failures—Missing Major Aspect and Lack of Context—so they are comparable on the most important criteria. consistency_internal.explantion: Both responses exhibit the same high‑severity internal‑consistency failures: each contains blurred viewpoints/conflation, attribution failures, and false‑consensus statements.
